profile.headline: Founder at OntologicAI -- Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an experienced Software Engineer passionate about building robust, innovative solutions that drive real business value. My background spans the medical device industry, healthcare IT, academic research, and consulting, giving me a unique perspective on quality, precision, and problem-solving.

My technical toolkit includes Python, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, and cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS. I have delivered end-to-end systems: from architecting scalable APIs and developing user-facing applications to automating data validation and advancing QA automation. I take pride in my ability to bridge business, frontend, and backend teams to streamline deployments while advocating for strong documentation and requirements alignment.

Recently, as Head Engineer at Ontologic LLM, I led the design and implementation of a custom Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform, combining dense and sparse vector search to enable precise, context-aware question answering. My work has included building advanced AI-powered chatbot platforms, designing custom prompt workflows, and deeply integrating LLMs into web applications to deliver tailored, domain-specific user experiences.

I thrive in collaborative, fast-paced teams and enjoy mentoring others, driving process improvements, and tackling complex technical challenges. Whether leading a cross-functional engineering initiative, teaching SQL best practices, or optimizing data flows between multiple systems, I am driven by curiosity, ownership, and a commitment to excellence.

Let’s connect if you’re interested in building intelligent, scalable solutions that make a difference.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: • Redesign of process by which member coverage information is propagated to government and commercial user portals leading to a 50% decrease in quantity of eligibility related tickets created per day

positions.title: Founder - Principal Engineer/Architect
positions.description:
• Founded a startup delivering AI/ML solutions focused on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combining dense and sparse vector searches using Qdrant and custom workflows.
• Architected and deployed a Python FastAPI application on Cloudflare, handling all API design, backend engineering, and cloud infrastructure.
• Collaborated with PhD in Philosophy SMEs to design and validate AI workflows for philosophical question-answering, ensuring technical rigor and clarity.
• Implemented documentation-as-code processes using Git and Markdown to ensure version control and continuous improvement based on user feedback.
positions.insights: Skills: Start-up Leadership · Software Design · Automation & Process Improvement · Technical Writing · AI & Large Language Model (LLM) Solution Development · Business Ownership

positions.title: Software Application Developer II
positions.description:
• Architected and led the development of a unified C# API framework for interfacing with major EHR systems (VA, Cerner, Epic).

• Developed and demoed a TypeScript-based UI for R&D and executive review, securing stakeholder buy-in and streamlining cross-team collaboration.

• Engineered and deployed advanced chatbot platforms, building custom prompt workflows and enabling dynamic selection and hot-swapping of fine-tuned LLM models (including integration with Ollama) for tailored, domain-specific automation.

• Enhanced chatbot and query engine logic to support granular prompt templates per tool, improving contextual accuracy and user experience.

• Built a post-response tagging system for AI outputs, adding traceability and enabling index trend analysis across large datasets.

• Configured and managed Azure infrastructure, implementing CI/CD pipelines with Bitbucket for robust, automated deployments of both frontend and backend applications.

• Secured sensitive applications (such as Prodi.gy) behind Azure SSO with RBAC, building a Python FastAPI/Nginx reverse proxy to meet stringent security requirements.

• Led Agile scrum ceremonies and championed project documentation improvements by providing actionable feedback and aligning requirements with ongoing development.

• Refactored internal TypeScript tools to cache contextual history, enhancing usability and efficiency across business areas.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an automated framework to generate, execute, and update PractiTest test cases, seamlessly linking them to associated Jira tickets for full traceability.

•  Championed process improvements by advocating for real-time requirement updates, reducing lag between development and QA documentation.

• Secured developer-level access for SQA automation efforts, successfully influencing sysadmin resource policies and expanding the impact of automation across the team.

• Developed and validated Selenium-based automated test suites to verify frontend functionality against backend data, increasing test coverage and reliability.

• Drove adoption of modern QA tooling and best practices, accelerating test cycles and improving overall software quality.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Protected clients from regulatory fines by ensuring data quality and completeness during large, multi-state health insurance database migrations.

• Developed a Python-based data comparison framework to identify and report migration errors, ensuring data integrity across millions of records.

• Authored and executed complex SQL queries across four different databases to generate detailed client reports and business insights.

• Enhanced quality and reliability by reviewing deployed code, isolating problematic areas, and recommending targeted fixes.

• Expanded data validation sources by parsing EDI files and web scraping EHR pages, cross-verifying warehouse data for accuracy.

• Automated EDI file creation, submission, and validation with HIPAA-compliant Python workflows, saving hundreds of testing hours.

• Mentored and upskilled client DBAs in advanced SQL techniques, significantly improving financial reporting and query efficiency.

positions.title: Data & Process Automation Technician
positions.description:
• Empowered engineers with CRUD database access by discovering server credentials and developing tailored SQL queries to meet their operational needs.

• Automated complex reporting processes, reducing a 40-hour manual workflow to just 10 minutes using SQL and Excel VBA.

• Increased manufacturing efficiency by automating the creation of product measurement sheets, enabling reallocation of engineering resources to higher-value tasks.

• Updated and standardized work instructions, improving alignment between customer expectations and inspection procedures, and enhancing overall product quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Automation & Process Improvement · Microsoft SQL Server · Rapid Learning of New Skills & Software Stacks · Cross-functional Collaborations · Quality Assurance (QA)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to design and prototype an experimental framework analyzing the modulation of selective attention.
  
• Developed digital tools and implemented pilot-testing protocols to gather data, evaluate experimental parameters, and optimize study controls.

• Presented research design and preliminary findings to the Institutional Review Board, in order to secure approval and funding consideration for project continuation.

positions.title: Software & Process Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Supported manufacturing operations by maintaining and troubleshooting custom production tracking software, ensuring real-time data accuracy for post-machining processes on precision medical devices.

• Developed scripts to automate workstation quality checks and digital logging, reducing manual entry errors and improving compliance with quality standards.

• Collaborated with engineering teams to implement digital solutions for cross-contamination prevention and line-clearance verification, streamlining operational efficiency in a regulated environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Automation & Process Improvement · Rapid Learning of New Skills & Software Stacks · Cross-functional Collaborations

positions.title: Software Process Technician & Cell Lead
positions.description:
• Automated post-machining process monitoring by creating SQL queries and Python scripts for quality data collection, heat-treatment tracking, and passivation validation on medical devices.

• Led a process improvement initiative to digitize status reporting, providing engineering and quality teams with real-time dashboard updates on production metrics and error trends.

• Trained team members on new digital tools and best practices for data-driven quality assurance, enhancing departmental communication and regulatory compliance.

• Acted as technical liaison between production and IT, identifying workflow automation opportunities and supporting the integration of software into daily manufacturing operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Automation & Process Improvement · Rapid Learning of New Skills & Software Stacks · Cross-functional Collaborations
